{{Quote|Brrrr-doop&hellip;|R5-X2|<ref name="Podracing" />}}
'''R5-X2''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] owned by [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] before ownership of it was transferred to [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt. The [[droid]] frequently traveled with it's new owner and was used to calculate odds of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] events. During [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]], R2-X2 would recalculate Jabba's potential winnings and later report them. 

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the droid accompanied Jabba to the [[Imperial Station Bravo|palace]] of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the Hutt on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to determine the odds of the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] Podrace. Gardulla's [[computer analyzer]] predicted that [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racer]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] would win the race. R5-X2, however, had determined the [[Racer/Legends|racer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] would win, with a small chance the racer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] could win. The droid later stayed by Jabba during the race, which Skywalker finished first in.

==Biography==
===Gambling droid===
{{Quote|Greetings, Jabba! And a warm welcome to your two companions.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Companions? Bwah! Bib Fortuna and R5-X2 are my servants, Gardulla.|Gardulla and Jabba|translated=1|<ref name="Podracing">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
R5-X2 was a [[R5-series astromech droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="FF100" /> It was originally owned by [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] before the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" /> took ownership<ref name="CSWE" /> of the droid as repayment of debt after discovering it was programmed to run [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] simulations.<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" /> R5-X2 often traveled with the criminal and was used to calculate the odds of gambling events like [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]], garbage pit racing, and [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]].<ref name="FF100" /> When at the Podraces, it would constantly recalculate the odds of the race<ref name="FF37" /> and calculate Jabba's potential winnings,<ref name="Insider109">{{InsiderCite|109|Menace Revisited|reprint=1}}</ref> reporting them when done.<ref name="FF37">{{FactFile|37|AST 5-6|Astromech Droids}}</ref> Jabba suspected he had been tricked with the droid, as his recommendations had proved worthless to him.<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The events of "[[Podracing Tales]]'' happen concurrently to the events of the film.</ref> R5-X2 was on<ref name="Podracing" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tatooine<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" /> and traveled on<ref name="Podracing" /> Jabba's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]''<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> with the Hutt<ref name="Podracing" /> and his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]],<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" /> [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to visit the [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|palace]] of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the Hutt.<ref name="Podracing" /> Once they arrived at their destination, the group disembarked off the sail barge to enter the palace so<ref name="Podracing" /> Jabba could attend his planned meeting with Gardulla on the topic of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|upcoming Boonta Eve Classic]] Podrace. Gardulla, seeking to slight Jabba,<ref name="FF100" /> offered a warm welcome to R5-X2 and Fortuna, but Jabba discounted them as servants.<ref name="Podracing" />

===Making calculations===
{{Quote|R5-X2 has determined that Sebulba will win&hellip; &hellip;Gasgano will come in second&hellip; &hellip;and Mawhonic will be third.|Jabba presents R5-X2's calculations to Gardulla|<ref name="Podracing" />|translated=1}}
Gardulla then introduced her scale model of the podracing course for the race, which was wired into a<ref name="Podracing" /> [[computer analyzer]] to calculate the race's odds.<ref name="FF100" /> The computer determined the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racer]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] would win the race, but R5-X2 determined the [[Racer/Legends|racer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] would win, Gasgano would place second, and racer [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]] would be third. The droid also predicted the racer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] would have<ref name="Podracing" /> an outside chance at victory.<ref name="FF100" /> Gardulla found the idea of Skywalker winning preposterous and bet that if he won, she would eat her computer. Jabba took her up on it and left with R5-X2 and Fortuna.<ref name="Podracing" />

R5-X2 later accompanied Jabba to the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> staying in the royal box area of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] with him.<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> It's prediction of Sebulba winning the race did not happen, but it's other prediction, Skywalker, did finish first.<ref name="TPM" /> Gardulla's rivalry with Jabba continued [[Standard year/Legends|years]] afterwards and it was likely R5-X2 played a hand in the dispute between them.<ref name="FF100" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|An interesting hypothesis, Gardulla, but my droid calculates a different conclusion|Jabba to Gardulla|<ref name="Podracing" />|translated=1}}  
[[File:R5X2-FF100.png|thumb|right|200px|R5-X2 did not share the unreliability of other R5-series droids.]]
Standing at 0.97 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], R5-X2 had [[Color/Legends|red]] and white plating<ref name="CSWE" /> and sensors the same colors. It did not share the common traits R5-series units had, such as being irritating and unreliable. A possibly for this was that the droid had been completely refurbished, or that it was a mistake model that was produced in good condition. Whatever what had happened to the droid, Jabba had come to rely on it and was very satisfied with it.<ref name="FF100" />

Jabba, who viewed most droids as disposable, held a soft spot for the perky and incisive droid, who frequently traveled with him. When Gardulla tried to slight the Hutt by asking him to introduce R2-X2, Jabba referred to it as a servant, as no being was viewed as a peer to a Hutt. Even with the Hutt's dependence on the droid, R2-X2 knew it's place with him. It was part of the small number of droids who served the crime lord for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]].<ref name="FF100" />

==Equipment==
A secret [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] was installed on the droid by Marlo.<ref name="UpdatedTPMVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
In 2009, via ''[[Star Wars Insider 107]]'', [[Hasbro]] announced that as part of the ''Return of the Jedi'' Build-A-Droid wave they would be releasing the droid: "R5-H6, seen with Gardulla the Hutt in ''The Phantom Menace''". That particular droid however, had already been released under the name "R5-X2". The droid that was subsequently released as part of the 2009 wave was in fact [[R5-C7]], a droid seen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during ''Attack of the Clones''.
